any resource can be either processed or copied byte for byte.
The "process" action is usually the recommended choice,

If the file type is unknown,
or no special processing is needed for the platform,
the file will be copied.
The processing rules are applied recursively
to every file under a directory,

The "copy" action is appropriate

Copying doesn't do any transformation at all,

to copy a source file that would normally have been compiled
